name: singlet_spatial_preproc_transcript_cell_assignment
title: Transcript-to-cell assignment
description: Assigns each transcript in an imaging spatial section to a cell or to background, and writes per-transcript labels, cell polygons and a cell-by-gene count matrix. The default baysor_mixture uses a nucleus or stain-derived prior when one is given; proseg always requires one. Use it on transcript tables with x, y and gene; do not use it on spot or bin data, or to score an existing segmentation.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI with a points table of x, y and gene.

method.description: Assignment model; baysor_mixture is the proposed default. segger needs a morphology image for its default initialisation.

prior_source.description: Prior raster from labels/. Vendor cell IDs are never accepted; proseg requires a prior.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for the stochastic E-step of baysor_mixture. The proseg source has no seed option, so its repeated executions are reported as a spread.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without fitting.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

baysor.description: Options for method baysor_mixture; other methods ignore them.

scale.description: Cell radius in microns; -1 estimates it from the prior and needs prior_source other than none.

scale_std.description: Spread of scale across cells, absolute or percentage.

min_molecules_per_cell.description: Minimum molecules for a cell call; must be positive.

prior_segmentation_confidence.description: Confidence in the prior segmentation, from 0 to 1.

n_clusters.description: Number of composition clusters for the mrf method.

force_2d.description: Ignore the z column, as the benchmark wrapper does.

proseg.description: Options for method proseg; other methods ignore them.

voxel_size_um.description: Voxel size in x and y, in microns.

burnin_voxel_size_um.description: Burn-in voxel size in microns; an integer multiple of voxel_size_um.

voxel_layers.description: Number of z layers in the voxel lattice.

burnin_samples.description: Samples taken at the burn-in voxel size.

ncomponents.description: Negative-binomial mixture components for cell expression.

cell_compactness.description: Compactness prior; smaller values give rounder cells.

diffusion_probability.description: Prior probability that a transcript is diffused and repositioned.

diffusion_sigma_near_um.description: Repositioning SD for non-diffused transcripts, in microns.

diffusion_sigma_far_um.description: Repositioning SD for diffused transcripts, in microns.

nuclear_reassignment_prob.description: Prior probability that the initial nuclear assignment is wrong.

segger.description: Options for method segger; other methods ignore them.

n_epochs.description: Training epochs for the link predictor.

prediction_expansion_ratio.description: Fraction of each polygon's equivalent radius used to expand it for prediction.

init_segmentation.description: Initial boundaries: cellpose from morphology, or auto, which uses the vendor cell ID when present.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, for example points/transcript_cell_id. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, n_transcripts, n_cells, call_rate, background_fraction, prior_source and the effective parameters.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
